title: File:Hope for Ukraine - Flickr - Don Komarechka.jpg
art: Don Komarechka from Barrie, Ontario, Canada
desc: In a similar fashion to one of the first images I made in the Support for Ukraine series, here we have a dandelion seed as the foundation for water droplets, refracting the image of the Ukrainian flag in the background. This time, sheets of sparkling paper were used. This makes for a lively effect,
